title: resolve_since_counters refactor: clean elimination of duplicated state-parse logic
description: The resolve_since_counters private helper correctly factors out 12 lines of identical token-parse + DB-read logic shared between get_changes_since and get_changes_since_ordered. The helper is private (not pub), has a clear single responsibility, and is the right level of abstraction — not thinner than the boilerplate it replaces. Resist any future suggestion to inline it back; the duplication was a footgun and will return if the state token format ever needs to change.
